title: Finite circuit: coupled k8 gauges escape coordinate minimum and certify pair stationarity
body:
PR1263 explicitly leaves coupled moves around its 237-helper gauge open. This package finds exactly two improving pairs, applies two fully priced moves, and then certifies **all-integer two-coordinate stationarity for every one of the 27,966 helper pairs**, separately in both orientations.

**Finite scalar construction and scoped negative result; no new kappa or global optimum.** The extra saving is six primitives per complex invocation: total savings from the original word become 13,006, with full scalar bills **135,996 / 136,012**. Paid recursive profiles and all nonscalar events remain unchanged. The result closes the predecessor's stated local-search question rather than claiming a material bound improvement.

- L400/L409 change together with real delta −2, although their separate changes total +2; L482/L494 give −1 rather than separate +5. Shared ADD interactions are charged once. The final 216 nonzero gauges retain all entry/exit work: 630 real boundary primitives.
- Adapted and credited PR1214 affine-cell argument covers arbitrary integer pair changes around an arbitrary fixed nonzero gauge, including shifted boundary costs and unit discounts. PR1214 instead starts from zero with at most two nonzero gauges. Three complete censuses per orientation finish in two strict descent steps; no triple or global lower bound is inferred.
- A separate implementation uses literal PR696 lowering, exhaustive [-31,31]² grids for 2,414 interacting pairs, and separate minima for 25,552 other pairs: **25,601,436 integer evaluations**, all final pair minima agreeing. Its eligibility list is independently derived.
- Complete 712-column scalar endpoints and six literal primitive dirty-state fixtures pass. Positive local bounds remain 52/68 bits, denominator depths 24/26; this does not revise global precision admission.

Only `research/k8-coupled-gauge-stationarity/` is added. Base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; source pins authenticate PR1263 `5fbaca13028846bddbb001e8e07addc2ab8e5816`, PR1214 `26162c56ec9c50a80e49949f36d4dd9a137a76a6`, the actual selected PR1094 provider and retained PR1161/PR696 sources. Substantial predecessor code is explicitly reused, not represented as a code-disjoint replay.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-coupled-gauge-stationarity
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/k8-coupled-gauge-stationarity outcome=completed`.

Local validation: seven package test groups, 80 synthetic exhaustive three-helper cases (240 pair domains), eight deliberate scalar-map failures, certificate/source corruptions, registered Python 3.12 and optimized Python 3.14 replays, full relocation to a path containing spaces, and 45 repository tests (one existing skip). Final overlap check covered 800 open PR bodies and 22 discussions; the [claim in discussion1258](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1258#discussioncomment-18910213) records the distinction. Selected frontier and upstream files are untouched.

No new native C++, full hosted/controller admission, selected cold replay, Lean or independent human proof review is asserted. Inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit obligations remain. README/TASK include concrete next questions. No composition with phase-varying gauges or stage-SCALE merging.

Credit Hanson Sun / @bbMisk, @woklerx, Sagar Thakrar, icekylinx, Jeremy Kothe, Rohan Arun, Hao Yan, Douglas Colkitt and the retained lineage. Prepared for **Philipp (@mightyOil)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex / GPT-6 Astra** assistance in mathematics, code, verification and writing; both implementations are AI-assisted. Apache-2.0; original notices retained.
